description:
After US-003 removed the only producer of the 'reviewer' sentinel, the 'reviewer' member of the AnySentinelSource union is now unreachable (parseAnySentinel only returns 'implementer' or 'review-tag'). Pruning it is out of this story's AC scope; consider a follow-up cleanup.

Source: cam/issue-233
Review round: 1
Location: src/supervisor/result.ts:372

suggestion-fingerprint: 057005e3aa27

acceptanceCriteria: The 'reviewer' member is removed from the AnySentinelSource union type in src/supervisor/result.ts (line ~371), leaving 'implementer' | 'review-tag'.
No producer or consumer of AnySentinelSource references the removed member (verified: parseAnySentinel returns only 'implementer' or 'review-tag'; no .source === 'reviewer' branch exists anywhere).

The unrelated 'reviewer' usages are NOT touched: the per-phase model/config name ('reviewer' in src/config/models.ts, src/commands/config.ts, src/ui/ConfigScreen.tsx) and the tmux @cam_label pane label ('reviewer' in src/tmux/session.ts, src/supervisor/loop.ts) are different concepts and remain.
typecheck and the full test suite pass green.
spec.scope: Prune the unreachable 'reviewer' member of the AnySentinelSource union in src/supervisor/result.ts, left dead after US-003 (cam/issue-233) removed its only producer. One-line type change plus any comment touch-up. No behavior change.
gotchas: 'reviewer' is heavily overloaded in the codebase: it is a per-phase model-config name AND a tmux pane @cam_label, both unrelated to the AnySentinelSource sentinel source. Only the AnySentinelSource union member is dead; do NOT remove the phase name or the pane label.

parseAnySentinel (result.ts:391) only ever returns source 'implementer' or 'review-tag'; its docstring already lists just those two detections, so the 'reviewer' union member has been unreachable since US-003.
There is no exhaustiveness switch on AnySentinelSource that would need a 'reviewer' case removed (no consumer branches on .source === 'reviewer').
